preconditions.description: n is a positive integer within the range [1, 10^9]

preconditions.expression: a1 >= 0 and a2 >= 0 and a3 >= 0 and a1 + a2 + a3 == n
preconditions.description: a1, a2, a3 are non-negative integers summing to n, representing Alice's rock, scissors, paper counts

preconditions.expression: b1 >= 0 and b2 >= 0 and b3 >= 0 and b1 + b2 + b3 == n
preconditions.description: b1, b2, b3 are non-negative integers summing to n, representing Bob's rock, scissors, paper counts

postconditions.description: stdout contains exactly two integers: the minimum and maximum number of rounds Alice can win, with min_wins ≤ max_wins

postconditions.expression: min_wins == max(min(a3, b1), min(a1, b2), min(a2, b3))
postconditions.description: min_wins is the minimum possible wins Alice can achieve by optimally pairing her moves to minimize wins: min(paper vs rock, rock vs scissors, scissors vs paper)

postconditions.expression: max_wins == min(n, a3 + b1 + a1 + b2 + a2 + b3) - max(0, (a1 + a2 + a3) - (b1 + b2 + b3))
postconditions.description: max_wins is the maximum possible wins Alice can achieve by optimally pairing her moves to maximize wins, accounting for all possible winning combinations (paper vs rock, rock vs scissors, scissors vs paper) and subtracting unavoidable losses/draws

postconditions.expression: min_wins >= 0 and max_wins >= 0 and min_wins <= n and max_wins <= n
postconditions.description: Both min_wins and max_wins are non-negative and do not exceed the total number of rounds n
